page.overview:
Who is Barny the Fruitbat?

Barny the Fruitbat was a male fruit bat and the mascot for the Ballycastle Bats Quidditch team in the 20th and 21st centuries.

Barny was featured in advertisements for Butterbeer, with the slogan Barny says: I'm just batty about Butterbeer!

At some point during the 2008–2009 school year, Barney participated in the mascot showcase at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry, where he was observed by a group of students consisting of a Muggle-born wizard and their friends.
